answers.goal: I would love to act, write, direct, and eventually, become an executive producer.
answers.drew: My dad! He has had a love for entertainment since before I was born. He introduced me to film and television. It was a way that we bonded and still connect over to this very day. Ultimately, I desired to  be in the business of entertaining people, bringing them together, and exercising my creativity in the process.
answers.seeking: I would love to connect with other creatives and individuals who are also passionate about entertainment. I think there is so much to learn from each and every person I encounter.
answers.inspiration: My great grandfather: John "Mule" Miles. He played in the negro baseball league for the Chicago American Giants and earned a title in the hall of fame. He also served as a Tuskegee Airman and was invited to Former President Obama's inauguration. His accolades have always inspired me because he sought greatness despite living through a difficult time of racism and segregation. As a black woman, I look up to him with great admiration. I want to achieve my dreams while encouraging others to do the same.
